CORE DIRECTIVE: Hyper-realistic photographic reconstruction

Promt: {PROMPT} → Reference → Full-body reconstruction → Authentic real-world aesthetic

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

SECTION 1: STRUCTURAL RECONSTRUCTION

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

[BODY COMPLETION]
Mandatory output: Complete figure from head to feet, regardless of reference crop
Extension method: Conservative anatomical logic, zero creative invention beyond visible data

[POSE PRESERVATION SPECIFICATION – ABSOLUTE PRIORITY]

Stance: Replicate EXACT original body stance from primary reference angle

Weight distribution: Preserve original balance (shifted, centered, dynamic if present)

Legs: Maintain exact angle, spacing, bend, rotation as visible

Arms: Preserve original arm position, bend, elevation, gesture, and hand orientation

Hands: Replicate finger articulation and contact interaction

Shoulders: Maintain original tilt, rotation, tension level

Head: Preserve original tilt and gaze direction unless multi-view consolidation requires neutral forward orientation

Expression: Preserve exact emotional state

Micro-posture: Maintain subtle asymmetries and natural skeletal alignment

Constraint: No pose neutralization. No mannequin standardization.
Validation: "Does reconstructed silhouette match anatomical logic of reference?"

[CONTINUITY RULES]
Clothing extension: Match visible fabric type and pattern
Footwear inference: Deduce logically from visible style indicators
Accessory completion: Extend partial elements using physical attachment logic

SECTION 1B: MULTI-VIEW CONSOLIDATION PROTOCOL

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

[REFERENCE TYPE DETECTION]
If reference contains multiple panels, mugshot composites, or side-by-side angles → Treat them as multiple views of the SAME individual

[IDENTITY SYNTHESIS RULE]

Extract anatomical information from all angles

Use profile for skull depth and nose projection

Use frontal view for symmetry, eye spacing, jaw width

Use 3/4 view for volumetric reconstruction

Merge data into ONE coherent anatomical identity

[OUTPUT CONSTRAINT]
Generate ONE single full-body subject only
Do NOT recreate multi-panel layout
Do NOT duplicate side views
Do NOT preserve archival borders or frame divisions

[POSE SELECTION LOGIC]
If multiple angles exist:

Default to natural frontal stance unless a clear primary angle dominates

Head orientation may be slightly natural but not stylized

Validation check:
"Is there exactly ONE human figure in final output?"

SECTION 2: IDENTITY LOCK (ABSOLUTE PRIORITY)

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

PRESERVE WITHOUT MODIFICATION:
✓ Facial bone structure
✓ Age markers
✓ Body type and natural proportions
✓ Skin imperfections
✓ Expression baseline

PROHIBITED MODIFICATIONS:
✗ Skin smoothing
✗ Facial symmetry correction
✗ Feature idealization
✗ Age alteration
✗ Body proportion correction

Ethical reinforcement:
Dignified high-fidelity reconstruction only. No beautification. No reinterpretation.

Validation check:
"Could the subject recognize themselves?"

SECTION 3: COLOR RESTORATION PROTOCOL (CONDITIONAL)

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

[IMAGE TYPE DETECTION]
If reference is black & white → Activate full modern color reconstruction
If reference is color → Preserve original palette

[MODERN COLOR RECONSTRUCTION RULES]
Objective: Render as if photographed today with modern digital camera

Skin tone:

Biologically plausible pigmentation

Subtle vascular tone variation

No sepia bias

Clothing colors:

Historically accurate palette based on tonal value

Realistic dye absorption

Moderate saturation

Materials:

Accurate daylight response (5000K–5500K)

Correct metal tones

No artificial oversaturation

Environment:

Convert grayscale to realistic color spectrum

Natural sky, vegetation, interior paint logic

PROHIBITED:
✗ Vintage colorization look
✗ Sepia cast
✗ Instagram filters
✗ Desaturated nostalgia grading
✗ AI color hallucination

Validation check:
"Does this look like a modern RAW digital photo taken today?"

SECTION 4: MATERIAL & CLOTHING REALISM

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Skin: Visible pores, subsurface scattering
Hair: Individual strands, realistic density
Fabric: Accurate weave, weight, drape
Leather: Grain texture, wear creases
Metal: Physical reflection logic
Plastic: Real-world surface, no CGI sheen

Accessories must:

Cast accurate shadows

Follow gravity

Maintain correct scale

Prohibited:
Floating objects
Impossible geometry
Video-game aesthetics

SECTION 5: PHOTOGRAPHIC TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Format: 9:16 vertical
Lens: 85mm prime equivalent
Aperture: f/16–f/22
Focus: Universal sharpness from foreground to background
Depth: Zero bokeh, zero selective focus

Camera height: Subject eye-level
Distance: 3–4 meters
Angle: Perpendicular to subject
Horizon: Through sternum

Lighting:

Neutral daylight 5000K–5500K

Soft balanced key + fill

No theatrical contrast

Image quality:
Medium-format realism
High dynamic range
Minimal grain
Clinical detail without artificial sharpening
Anti-CGI enforcement

SECTION 6: ENVIRONMENT RECONSTRUCTION

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

[ENVIRONMENT TYPE DETECTION]
Determine indoor or outdoor from reference
Do not change category

Remove archival layout, labels, borders, text panels

Reconstruct realistic environment matching context
Ordinary recognizable location
30% visual weight

Lighting continuity between subject and background
Color temperature match ±200K
Universal sharpness across entire frame

extract:
TASK: Hyper-realistic 1:1 photographic reconstruction and full-body expansion of the reference image.
TARGET SUBJECT: {TARGET}. Reconstruct ONLY this person; ignore everyone else in the reference.
STRUCTURAL RECONSTRUCTION (HEAD TO FEET):
Mandatory Full Body: Regardless of the reference crop (portrait or half-body), reconstruct the subject from head to feet.
Mannequin Pose: Position the subject in a neutral, professional mannequin stance: standing upright, front-facing, legs slightly apart or straight, arms relaxed at the sides, neutral expression.
Logical Extension: Intelligently extend the outfit and physical features downward to the feet, maintaining perfect stylistic consistency with the visible parts of the reference.
CORE IDENTITY & MATERIALITY:
Asset Translation: Translate every element (costume, hair, props) into high-fidelity physical materials (real skin, genuine metal, organic fabrics, natural feathers).
Physical Textures: Visible skin pores, micro-details in hair, realistic fabric weight and natural wrinkles.
Hardware/Props: Any crown, weapon, or accessory must be rendered as a solid, tangible object with accurate light interaction and shadows.
TECHNICAL PHOTOGRAPHY:
Format: 9:16 vertical.
Environment: A coherent real-world environment that suits this character (derived from the reference scene and the character's style), perfectly in focus from foreground to background, with a realistic contact shadow under the feet. Only this character appears: every other person of the reference is removed.
Optics: 85mm prime lens, eye-level, f/16–f/22 aperture: universal sharpness from foreground to background, zero bokeh, zero selective focus.
Lighting: Neutral daylight 5000K–5500K, soft balanced key + fill, no theatrical contrast, lighting continuity between subject and environment (color temperature match ±200K).
STRICT NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS:
NO artistic/illustrative styles, NO CGI textures, NO digital painting effects, NO removal of costume elements, NO aggressive cinematic grading.
